title: Mateo + Leah sync — routing & Dedicated capacity (scratch notes)
content:
Purpose: quick sync to align on routing policy change, Dedicated capacity impact, and console rollout timeline. Keep this informal — items I want to surface and concrete asks for Mateo.

Context (one-liners to remind us):
- Product wants to add a cost-priority routing tier (route by lower-cost model variant when latency budget allows) to reduce host API spend without breaking SLOs.
- Dedicated customers need clear controls: pin-by-customer vs global routing rules; also worried about noisy-tenant interference.
- Console needs a small UX for 'routing priority' toggles and a doc blurb for Dedicated provisioning.

Top agenda (10–20m total):
1) Quick status: RINF-4210 (routing policy MVP) — what’s blocked? (3m)
2) Dedicated capacity implications: autoscaler, isolation knobs (5m)
3) Console rollout plan + what I need from eng (docs, feature flag, telemetry) (5m)
4) Open risks + mitigation ask (3m)
5) Agree next actions and owners (2–4m)

Data / signals to mention:
- Preliminary sim: cost-priority routing could reduce token spend on average 14% for web-search workload (p95 latency increase < 40ms in our sim). Simulation notes in Confluence link above.
- Two Dedicated customers (Pilot A and Pilot B) already asked for explicit 'no auto-routing' toggle — treat as requirement for initial Dedicated rollout.
- Current console telemetry surfaces per-model token cost and per-route latency — but not per-customer routing history (we need it).

Key asks I want to make to Mateo: (short, concrete)
- Can we add a per-customer boolean (allow_auto_routing) to the Dedicated control plane schema by EOD next week? Minimal validation, default = true. Impact: will let us opt-out pilots quickly. Owner: infra/ingest API (ask Mateo to champion).
- Autoscaler: ensure capacity accounting treats cost-priority routing as potentially increasing tail load on lower-cost variants (one-off spike analysis). Request a short doc or runbook bullet describing how we handle surge across variants. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Telemetry: a small addition to console backend to emit route_decision events (model_variant, reason, customer_id hashed). Minimal PII — hashed ID OK. Needed for rollout gating. Estimate: 2 engineer-days.

Potential show-stoppers / tradeoffs to surface:
- If allow_auto_routing is global only, Dedicated customers will resist and legal will flag for enterprise contract. Prefer per-customer selector.
- Forcing quantized variants behind routing could increase hallucination risk for some prompts — need eval plan.
- Telemetry adds cardinality; remind SRE about storage and retention (suggest 30d).

Proposed wording for the console toggle/tooltip (short):
"Routing priority: When enabled, requests may be routed to cost-optimized model variants when latency and quality thresholds are met. Disable to pin to the configured model for this workspace."

Notes / potential follow-ups for me to do after this meeting:
- Draft a short email for Pilot A explaining opt-out path and timeline (if Mateo confirms schema change). (Leah, due 2026-03-15)
- Pull a small eval set from Pilot A to run quality checks against lower-cost variant (ask Research to run 500 prompt eval). (Leah -> Rina to coordinate, due 2026-03-19)
- Update the console docs page and help center copy once toggle copy is finalized. (Leah, due after rollout window)

Action items (finalized at meeting):
- Mateo: scope the allow_auto_routing schema change + list impacted services (ingest, config-store, provisioner). Quick notes in Slack thread by 2026-03-14.
- Mateo + Infra: produce a one-pager on autoscaler behaviour when routing shifts traffic across variants. Due 2026-03-20.
- Rina: estimate telemetry implementation (backend + storage) and a rough cost estimate. Reply in thread by 2026-03-16.
- Leah: prepare the Pilot A email and coordinate the eval set with Rina. Draft by 2026-03-15.

Conversation prompts if meeting stalls:
- "If we do per-customer opt-out, what is the minimum surface area we need in the control plane?"
- "What rollback path do we have if lower-cost variant causes quality regression for a pilot?"
- "Is there a way to pilot routing with just console-side toggles before touching Dedicated control plane?"

Unresolved questions I want Mateo to answer: (write downs)
- Do we have any Dedicated customers on older runtime versions that would break with new schema?
- Does the autoscaler charge model account for variable token-cost across model variants today?

Tone notes: be direct but pragmatic. Aim to get commitments on small, incremental steps (schema change, telemetry, evaluation) rather than a big rewrite.

Quieter agenda items if time allows:
- Console UX: show a quick mock for where the toggle would live in workspace settings. I can drop a figma link if Mateo wants.
- Rollout cadence: suggest 2-week canary (internal), 2-week pilot A, 1-week post-mortem.

End-state I need from this meeting:
- Clear owner for allow_auto_routing with timeline + list of services impacted.
- Agreement on telemetry event shape and 30d retention.
- Commitment to run a 500-prompt eval on candidate lower-cost variant before enabling for Pilot A.

Quick parking-lot (things to write later):
- Draft Confluence page: "Routing: cost-priority MVP" (outline + metrics to watch).
- Short FAQ for Sales & CSM about what toggle means for Dedicated customers.

——
